task.title: P6-047: Add select-all-on-page and per-collection checkboxes to /my breakdown
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-047. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**No "select all on this page", and no per-collection checkbox in the `/my` location breakdown.** The header select column is an `sr-only`-labelled span with no control (`all_cards.rs:348-350`), and `LocationSummary`'s multi-collection branch is a plain `<ul>` of links (`:490-536`). The breakdown is the natural place for the user to resolve the oracle-grain ambiguity `P6-151` currently refuses — a `/my` selection names only the card, so a per-location checkbox would let the user answer "which copies?" directly instead of the app guessing.
